name: Darknet Marketplace Proceeds Laundering
description: Vendors and administrators of darknet markets receive payment in virtual assets for illicit goods and services, then move proceeds through intermediaries, mixers and exchanges to reach fiat. Customers also fund purchases through regulated platforms. Indicators appear in blockchain exposure, funnelling behaviour and cash-out patterns.

sources.text: FATF, Virtual Assets: Red Flag Indicators of Money Laundering and Terrorist Financing (2020)
FATF, Updated Guidance for a Risk-Based Approach to Virtual Assets and Virtual Asset Service Providers (2021)
FinCEN, Advisory on Illicit Activity Involving Convertible Virtual Currency (FIN-2019-A003, 2019)
Europol, Internet Organised Crime Threat Assessment (IOCTA) (annual; specify edition year)

exposure.rationale: Darknet vendors and buyers fund and cash out through crypto platforms and P2P sellers, with Tor/burner-based onboarding and gift-card/prepaid cash-out.

indicators.name: Direct exposure to known darknet market addresses
indicators.canon: Direct exposure to known darknet market addresses
indicators.desc: Customer deposits or withdrawals have direct or near-direct exposure to addresses attributed to darknet markets or their escrow wallets.
indicators.ctx: Customer deposits or withdrawals have direct or near-direct exposure to addresses attributed to darknet markets or their escrow wallets.
indicators.fp: Exposure through very diluted chains; researchers and journalists.

indicators.name: Frequent small purchases to marketplace-linked addresses
indicators.canon: Frequent small purchases to marketplace-linked addresses
indicators.desc: Repeated low-value withdrawals to wallets clustering with market deposit infrastructure, consistent with buyer activity.
indicators.ctx: Repeated low-value withdrawals to wallets clustering with market deposit infrastructure, consistent with buyer activity.

indicators.name: Vendor-style inflows from many unrelated senders
indicators.canon: Many unrelated senders paying a single account or recipient
indicators.desc: Numerous unrelated payers send frequent, often small, payments to one account, wallet or beneficiary, or one funder pays many beneficiaries, with no clear commercial relationship.
indicators.ctx: Account receives numerous small transfers from unconnected wallets then consolidates and sends onward in large amounts.
indicators.fp: Merchants, creators and fundraisers accepting crypto.

indicators.name: Use of privacy tools between market exposure and exchange deposit
indicators.canon: Use of mixers, privacy coins or privacy pools around platform activity
indicators.desc: Funds pass through mixers, privacy coins or privacy-preserving pools before or after platform activity without commercial rationale.
indicators.ctx: Funds from market clusters pass through mixers or privacy coins before arriving at the platform.

indicators.name: Operational-security behaviours at onboarding and login
indicators.canon: Operational-security behaviours at onboarding and login
indicators.desc: Use of Tor, disposable email, burner phones and rotated devices alongside high-volume trading.
indicators.ctx: Use of Tor, disposable email, burner phones and rotated devices alongside high-volume trading.

indicators.name: Cash-out through multiple accounts of same user group
indicators.canon: Cash-out through multiple accounts of same user group
indicators.desc: Proceeds are routed to several accounts sharing devices or beneficiaries and cashed out in fiat by different parties.
indicators.ctx: Proceeds are routed to several accounts sharing devices or beneficiaries and cashed out in fiat by different parties.

indicators.name: Income level unsupported by declared profile
indicators.canon: Account activity inconsistent with declared occupation or income
indicators.desc: Turnover or volumes materially exceed what the customer's declared occupation, income, age or circumstances would support.
indicators.ctx: Large virtual asset turnover for a customer who declared minimal income or no source of wealth.

indicators.name: Payments for postage, packaging or related services alongside crypto activity
indicators.canon: Payments for postage, packaging or related services alongside crypto activity
indicators.desc: Card and bank transactions to shipping supplies and anonymous mailbox services coincide with virtual asset sales or purchases.
indicators.ctx: Card and bank transactions to shipping supplies and anonymous mailbox services coincide with virtual asset sales or purchases.

indicators.name: Rapid withdrawal to personal cash via peer-to-peer sellers
indicators.canon: Rapid withdrawal to personal cash via peer-to-peer sellers
indicators.desc: Fiat-conversion occurs through informal P2P sellers paid by cash deposit or gift cards soon after receiving crypto.
indicators.ctx: Fiat-conversion occurs through informal P2P sellers paid by cash deposit or gift cards soon after receiving crypto.
indicators.fp: Legitimate P2P use in underbanked regions.

indicators.name: Law-enforcement or media notice naming customer or wallet
indicators.canon: Law-enforcement or media notice naming customer or wallet
indicators.desc: Third-party intelligence links the customer or addresses to marketplace activity.
indicators.ctx: Third-party intelligence links the customer or addresses to marketplace activity.
